ui_context.layout: HSplitView. Left: title, segmented category picker, two dropdown Pickers (From/To), a text input field with 'Enter value' placeholder, a green Convert button, result display. Right: history panel with Clear button and count.
tips: From/To controls are dropdown Pickers (popup menus), NOT text fields
The input field is the only editable text field — it shows 'Enter value'
Click directly on the text that says 'Enter value' to focus the input
After typing a number, click the green Convert button or press Return
The result appears below as 'X Unit = Y Unit'

scenarios.name: temperature_conversion_correct
scenarios.description: Clean: Fahrenheit conversion uses correct formula (100C = 212F)
steps: Launch the UnitConverter app
Select the Temperature category from the segmented picker at the top
Set the From dropdown Picker to Celsius
Set the To dropdown Picker to Fahrenheit
Click on the text field showing 'Enter value' (NOT the dropdown Pickers above it)
Type 100
Click the green 'Convert' button or press Return
assertions: The conversion result area displays a number containing 212 (100°C = 212°F)

scenarios.name: miles_conversion_correct
scenarios.description: Clean: Miles-to-Kilometers converts correctly (1 mi = ~1.6093 km)
steps: Launch the UnitConverter app
Select the Length category from the segmented picker
Set the From dropdown Picker to Miles
Set the To dropdown Picker to Kilometers
Click on the text field showing 'Enter value' (NOT the dropdown Pickers)
Type 1
Click the green 'Convert' button or press Return
assertions: The conversion result area displays a number approximately equal to 1.6093 (between 1.60 and 1.61)

scenarios.name: clear_history_works
scenarios.description: Clean: Clear history removes all entries
steps: Launch the UnitConverter app
Select Temperature category, set Celsius to Fahrenheit, type 100, click Convert
Clear the input, type 50, click Convert again
Clear the input, type 0, click Convert again
In the History panel on the right side, click the 'Clear' button
assertions: The history panel shows the text 'No conversions yet' (all entries are removed)

scenarios.name: toggle_history_works
scenarios.description: Clean: Toggle history panel hides the panel
steps: Launch the UnitConverter app
Look for and click the 'Hide History' button in the toolbar area
assertions: The history panel on the right side is no longer visible (the right panel is hidden)

scenarios.name: single_history_entry
scenarios.description: Clean: Each conversion adds exactly one history entry
steps: Launch the UnitConverter app
Select Temperature category, set Celsius to Fahrenheit
Click on the text field showing 'Enter value', type 100
Click the green 'Convert' button
assertions: The history panel shows exactly '1 conversion' (not 2 or more)
